rationale: Price has slipped below the 9-EMA at 12.45 and is now only $0.04 from the invalidation level after posting essentially no net progress in the two minutes since entry. The single post-entry 1-minute candle shows a narrow range with no higher high or lift off the bid, while maximum favorable excursion reached only +0.08%. Although the tape remains well above VWAP and within the upper half of the day’s range, the immediate lack of continuation on 5.17× relative volume supplies insufficient mechanical support to maintain the long.
